Name: Excalibur
Author: evilcookies98
Description: [size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod exists to replace the insect head with King Arthur's legendary sword Excalibur. At this current stage, the weapon must either be found via game progression or through SMAPI commands, but event triggers are planned if they can be made to work. Note, due to the visual impairment of the mod creator, the sword art had to be generated using AI. This was only done because the mod author is totally blind and had no other choice. Note 2, the weapon is overpowered, yes. This is intentional. This is Excalibur, not a common weapon. It's meant to be the good kind of busted. Note 3, this mod comes with a breadme to explain the commands to get the weapon before natural game progression would allow.[/color][/size]
